questions.question: What color are warning signs with black lettering or symbols?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions.

questions.question: For the best protection, jackets and pants should:

options.text: Cover your arms and legs completely.
Be loose and flap in the wind while you ride.
Only partially cover your arms and legs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cover your arms and legs completely.
questions.explanation: Jackets and pants should cover your arms and legs completely. They should fit snugly but allow you to move freely. Leather or synthetic materials offer the best protection in an accident.

questions.question: Before riding, check that:

options.text: The brakes make a loud squeaking noise.
The brakes cause friction with the steering.
Each brake can hold the motorcycle.
Only the rear brake can hold the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Each brake can hold the motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Test each brake lever before riding. Make sure each one feels firm and holds the motorcycle when fully applied.

questions.question: Which item does NOT protect a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Wear a DOT-approved helmet, eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, high boots that support your ankles, and durable gloves. A baseball cap does not provide protection.

questions.question: If a friend has been drinking and wants to ride their motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Encourage them to take quiet roads.
Get other friends to convince them not to ride.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get other friends to convince them not to ride.
questions.explanation: Never allow someone to ride after drinking. Do everything you can to stop them. Having multiple friends apply peer pressure can be effective.

questions.question: If stopping will take longer than usual, you should:
questions.explanation: On slippery surfaces, increase your following distance. If stopping takes longer than usual, stay further back from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: When someone is tailgating you, you should:

options.text: Slow down and let them pass.
Move to the shoulder and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let them pass.
questions.explanation: The best solution is to get the tailgater in front of you. Change lanes safely and let them pass. Speeding up may make them tailgate at the higher speed.

questions.question: When riding with a passenger, you should do all of the following, except:

options.text: Adjust your motorcycle for the passenger.
Tell the passenger to keep their feet on the footrests.

questions.explanation: Your motorcycle must have a permanent passenger seat and footrests to carry a passenger. Give instructions before you start riding.

questions.question: Before mounting a motorcycle, check all of the following, except:
questions.explanation: Before riding, check tire tread and air pressure, oil and fluid levels, lights, and signals. Paint damage does not affect safe riding.

questions.question: A motorcycle operator can improve visibility by:
questions.explanation: Wear bright clothing with reflective materials to be seen. Use your headlight at all times and use signals and brake lights properly.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should wear a jacket:

options.text: At all times, no matter the weather.
Only if you will ride for more than half an hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: At all times, no matter the weather.
questions.explanation: Always wear a long-sleeved jacket when riding, even in warm weather. It protects you from the sun and dehydration.

questions.question: Which type of clothing helps other drivers see you?
questions.explanation: Wear bright, reflective clothing to make yourself and your motorcycle easier for other drivers to see.

questions.question: Can clothing help prevent injuries in a crash?

options.text: No, clothing is not for protection.
No, clothing is just a personal choice.
Yes, but only if the clothes are very loose and flap in the wind.
Yes, if a jacket and pants cover your arms and legs completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, if a jacket and pants cover your arms and legs completely.
questions.explanation: Proper clothing reduces injury risk in a crash. Wear a snug jacket and pants made of sturdy material that cover your arms and legs completely.

questions.question: What is the main active ingredient in marijuana?
questions.explanation: THC (tetrahydrocannabinol) is the main active ingredient in marijuana.

questions.question: How often should you check your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need more frequent checks than cars. Do a complete inspection before every ride.

questions.question: What is the best source of information about your specific motorcycle?

options.text: Someone who owns a different type of motorcycle.
A television show about motorcycle riding.

questions.explanation: Read the owner's manual before riding. This is especially important if you are riding a borrowed motorcycle.

questions.question: If you feel tired while riding, you should:

options.text: Keep riding and hope you wake up.

questions.explanation: Do not ride if you are tired. Take rest breaks at least every two hours on long trips to avoid fatigue.

questions.question: When choosing your position in a lane, you should think about:

options.text: Whether other drivers can see you.
How many cars are ahead on the road.
Which lane position makes your trip shorter.
Which position lets you pass more vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Whether other drivers can see you.
questions.explanation: Choose a lane position that allows other drivers to see you and gives you enough space around your motorcycle.

questions.question: What should motorcycle riding clothes cover?

options.text: Your arms completely, but not your legs.
Your legs completely, but not your arms.
Whatever is most comfortable for you.

questions.explanation: Wear a jacket and pants that completely cover your arms and legs for proper protection.

questions.question: When downshifting, you should:

options.text: Shift down multiple gears at once.
Shift down one gear at a time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift down one gear at a time.
questions.explanation: When downshifting, shift down one gear at a time. Release the clutch slowly through the friction zone between each downshift.

questions.question: A rectangular sign is used for:
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs are rectangular with white background and black lettering. They show road rules. You must follow these signs.

questions.question: When should you do a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Check your motorcycle before every ride. It only takes a few minutes and helps prevent problems before you ride.

questions.question: What is correct when passing another vehicle?

options.text: You may drive faster than the speed limit while passing.
You may ignore "No passing" markings if you started in a legal zone.
You may pass on the shoulder of the road.
You must pass within the speed limit and only in legal passing zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must pass within the speed limit and only in legal passing zones.
questions.explanation: Always pass within the speed limit. Only pass where it is safe and the law allows it.

questions.question: What should you check during a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Before every ride, check your tires, oil, fluids, lights, turn signals, brake light, clutch, throttle, mirrors, brakes, and horn.

questions.question: What is a danger of riding next to parked cars?

options.text: You may not find a parking spot.
A driver may pull out suddenly into your path.
Other drivers may be looking for a parking spot and driving slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver may pull out suddenly into your path.
questions.explanation: Parked cars can be dangerous. A driver may pull out without looking. Car doors may open into your lane. Pedestrians may step out from between cars.
